instruction:
Create a Function Block named FB_CircuitControl to manage a power distribution system with the following specifications:

Inputs:

Reset_All_CB: BOOL (Reset signal for all circuit breakers)
Current_Fault_on_TRSF1: INT (Fault current on Transformer 1)
Current_Fault_on_66BUS1: INT (Fault current on 66kV Bus 1)


Outputs:

Short_Circuit_TRSF1: BOOL (Short circuit detection on Transformer 1)
Short_Circuit_66BUS: BOOL (Short circuit detection on 66kV Bus)
Open_CB1_66KV: BOOL (Status of Circuit Breaker 1 on 66kV side)
Open_CB2_66KV: BOOL (Status of Circuit Breaker 2 on 66kV side)
Open_CB_TRSF1: BOOL (Status of Circuit Breaker for Transformer 1)
Open_CB2_22KV: BOOL (Status of Circuit Breaker 2 on 22kV side)


Internal Variables:

Define a constant Threshold500 with value 500


Logic Implementation:
Implement the following logic in the order specified:
a) Implement short circuit detection:

Set Short_Circuit_66BUS to TRUE if Current_Fault_on_66BUS1 > Threshold500
Set Short_Circuit_TRSF1 to TRUE if Current_Fault_on_TRSF1 > Threshold500

b) Implement circuit breaker control logic in the following order:

Open_CB2_22KV:
Set to TRUE if any of these conditions are met:

Reset_All_CB is FALSE, AND
The previous state of Open_CB2_22KV was FALSE, AND
Either Open_CB1_66KV is TRUE and Open_CB_TRSF1 is TRUE, OR Short_Circuit_66BUS is TRUE


Open_CB1_66KV:
Set to TRUE if any of these conditions are met:

Reset_All_CB is FALSE, AND
Open_CB2_22KV is FALSE, AND
The previous state of Open_CB1_66KV was TRUE and Open_CB_TRSF1 is TRUE, OR Short_Circuit_66BUS is TRUE


Open_CB_TRSF1:
Set to TRUE if any of these conditions are met:

Reset_All_CB is FALSE, AND
Open_CB2_22KV is FALSE, AND
Open_CB1_66KV is TRUE and the previous state of Open_CB_TRSF1 was TRUE, OR Short_Circuit_66BUS is TRUE


Open_CB2_66KV:
Always set to TRUE
Update Open_CB2_22KV again:
Set to TRUE if any of these conditions are met:

Reset_All_CB is FALSE, AND
The previous state of Open_CB2_22KV was FALSE, AND
Open_CB2_66KV is TRUE and Open_CB1_66KV is TRUE and Open_CB_TRSF1 is TRUE, OR Short_Circuit_TRSF1 is TRUE


Update Open_CB1_66KV again:
Set to TRUE if any of these conditions are met:

Reset_All_CB is FALSE, AND
Open_CB2_22KV is FALSE, AND
Open_CB2_66KV is TRUE and the previous state of Open_CB1_66KV was TRUE and Open_CB_TRSF1 is TRUE, OR Short_Circuit_TRSF1 is TRUE


Update Open_CB_TRSF1 again:
Set to TRUE if any of these conditions are met:

Reset_All_CB is FALSE, AND
Open_CB2_22KV is FALSE, AND
Open_CB2_66KV is TRUE and Open_CB1_66KV is TRUE and the previous state of Open_CB_TRSF1 was TRUE, OR Short_Circuit_TRSF1 is TRUE


Additional Considerations:

Ensure the logic prevents rapid switching of circuit breaker states
Implement failsafe conditions to maintain system stability
The order of operations is crucial for the correct behavior of the system

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_CircuitControl
VAR_INPUT
Reset_All_CB : BOOL;
Current_Fault_on_TRSF1 : INT;
Current_Fault_on_66BUS1 : INT;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
Short_Circuit_TRSF1 : BOOL;
Short_Circuit_66BUS : BOOL;
Open_CB1_66KV : BOOL;
Open_CB2_66KV : BOOL;
Open_CB_TRSF1 : BOOL;
Open_CB2_22KV : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR
Current_CB1_66KV : INT;
Current_CB2_66KV : INT;
Current_TRSF1_W1 : INT;
Current_TRSF1_W2 : INT;
Current_CB_TRSF1 : INT;
Current_CB2_22KV : INT;
Threshold500 : INT := 500;
GT15_OUT : BOOL;
GT4_OUT : BOOL;
END_VAR

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Ensure that Short_Circuit_66BUS is set to TRUE when the fault current on 66kV Bus 1 exceeds the threshold.

property.pattern_description: {(instance.Current_Fault_on_66BUS1 > instance.Threshold500) = instance.Short_Circuit_66BUS} is always true at the end of the PLC cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Ensure that Short_Circuit_TRSF1 is set to TRUE when the fault current on Transformer 1 exceeds the threshold.

property.pattern_description: {(instance.Current_Fault_on_TRSF1 > instance.Threshold500) = instance.Short_Circuit_TRSF1} is always true at the end of the PLC cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Ensure that CB2_66KV is always open.

property.pattern_description: {instance.Open_CB2_66KV} is always true at the end of the PLC cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Test case 1: Normal operation with no faults

pattern_params.1: instance.Reset_All_CB = TRUE AND instance.Current_Fault_on_TRSF1 = 0 AND instance.Current_Fault_on_66BUS1 = 0 AND instance.Open_CB1_66KV = FALSE AND instance.Open_CB_TRSF1 = FALSE AND instance.Open_CB2_22KV = FALSE
pattern_params.2: NOT instance.Short_Circuit_TRSF1 AND NOT instance.Short_Circuit_66BUS AND instance.Open_CB2_66KV AND NOT instance.Open_CB1_66KV AND NOT instance.Open_CB_TRSF1 AND instance.Open_CB2_22KV

property.pattern_description: If all inputs are normal (no faults, all CBs closed), then no short circuits should be detected, CB2_66KV and CB2_22KV should be open, and all other CBs should be closed.

pattern_params.1: instance.Reset_All_CB = FALSE AND instance.Current_Fault_on_TRSF1 = 0 AND instance.Current_Fault_on_66BUS1 = 600 AND instance.Open_CB1_66KV = TRUE AND instance.Open_CB_TRSF1 = TRUE AND instance.Open_CB2_22KV = TRUE
pattern_params.2: NOT instance.Short_Circuit_TRSF1 AND instance.Short_Circuit_66BUS AND instance.Open_CB2_66KV AND NOT instance.Open_CB1_66KV AND NOT instance.Open_CB_TRSF1 AND instance.Open_CB2_22KV

property.pattern_description: If there's a fault on the 66kV Bus, then Short_Circuit_66BUS should be TRUE, CB2_66KV and CB2_22KV should be open, and CB1_66KV and CB_TRSF1 should be closed.

pattern_params.1: instance.Reset_All_CB = FALSE AND instance.Current_Fault_on_TRSF1 = 600 AND instance.Current_Fault_on_66BUS1 = 0 AND instance.Open_CB1_66KV = TRUE AND instance.Open_CB_TRSF1 = TRUE AND instance.Open_CB2_22KV = TRUE
pattern_params.2: instance.Short_Circuit_TRSF1 AND NOT instance.Short_Circuit_66BUS AND instance.Open_CB2_66KV AND instance.Open_CB1_66KV AND instance.Open_CB_TRSF1 AND NOT instance.Open_CB2_22KV

property.pattern_description: If there's a fault on Transformer 1, then Short_Circuit_TRSF1 should be TRUE, CB2_66KV, CB1_66KV, and CB_TRSF1 should be open, and CB2_22KV should be closed.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Test case 4: Reset operation after a fault

pattern_params.1: instance.Reset_All_CB = TRUE AND instance.Current_Fault_on_TRSF1 = 0 AND instance.Current_Fault_on_66BUS1 = 0 AND instance.Open_CB1_66KV = TRUE AND instance.Open_CB_TRSF1 = TRUE AND instance.Open_CB2_22KV = TRUE
pattern_params.2: NOT instance.Short_Circuit_TRSF1 AND NOT instance.Short_Circuit_66BUS AND instance.Open_CB2_66KV AND instance.Open_CB1_66KV AND NOT instance.Open_CB_TRSF1 AND NOT instance.Open_CB2_22KV

property.pattern_description: When resetting after a fault (all CBs initially open), no short circuits should be detected, CB2_66KV and CB1_66KV should remain open, while CB_TRSF1 and CB2_22KV should be closed.

pattern_params.1: instance.Reset_All_CB = FALSE AND instance.Current_Fault_on_TRSF1 = 500 AND instance.Current_Fault_on_66BUS1 = 500 AND instance.Open_CB1_66KV = FALSE AND instance.Open_CB_TRSF1 = FALSE AND instance.Open_CB2_22KV = FALSE
pattern_params.2: NOT instance.Short_Circuit_TRSF1 AND NOT instance.Short_Circuit_66BUS AND instance.Open_CB2_66KV AND NOT instance.Open_CB1_66KV AND NOT instance.Open_CB_TRSF1 AND instance.Open_CB2_22KV

property.pattern_description: At the fault current threshold, no short circuits should be detected, CB2_66KV and CB2_22KV should be open, and all other CBs should be closed.
